verdict.rationale: Marqeta is an API-driven card-issuing platform with configurable rules such as velocity controls, authorization controls and JIT funding decisions, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack documents nothing about version history, change review, or rollback for any configuration. Sandbox simulation and webhooks are adjacent features, not versioning, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
